summary: Alumis Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 1, 2026, announcing topline results from its Phase 2b LUMUS trial of envudeucitinib in systemic lupus erythematosus. The filing includes a press release and webcast slides as exhibits. No special-situation transaction or strategic corporate action is described. The company outlines regulatory submission plans and pipeline milestones but does not report any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other qualifying event. The filing is a routine operational update on clinical trial results, not a special-situation category. No deal terms, board actions, or advisors are stated. What to watch: subsequent regulatory interactions and potential strategic reviews of the TYK2 portfolio.
